title: On the Simulation Cost of Quantum Finite Automata
summary: This paper identifies exact probabilistic simulation cost as the natural quantitative measure of quantum advantage for finite automata under strict cutpoints. It gives sharp simulation laws for two representative models. A one-way finite automaton with $c$ classical states and a $q$-dimensional quantum register has exact probabilistic simulation cost $Θ(cq^2)$, while an $n$-dimensional measure-once one-way quantum finite automaton has worst-case cost $Θ(n^2)$.
